invite.scene.alt: Luca and Lunea welcome you through a doorway into a library of stories.
invite.guides.title: Every adventure needs
invite.guides.body: Luca is a captain who knows a lot, and is sometimes a little too sure of it. Lunea is cheerful, asks plenty of questions and spots what Luca walks right past. Today they are holding the door for you.
invite.faq.title: Before you
invite.guides.lucaLine: Stick with me. I know this library by heart.
invite.guides.luneaLine: You said that about the last library.
invite.ribbon.label: What you can do here
invite.offer.title: Special offer
invite.closing.free: Free to join. Paid plans add more tools.

invite.from.seoTitle: {from} is inviting you to Literary Universe
invite.from.sayHiBody: Add {from} as a friend and send them a message once you have an account.
invite.from.faqMemberA: Sign in and visit {from}'s profile to say hi.
invite.from.closingBody: Create a free account to read stories and keep in touch with {from}.
invite.from.memberNote: You're already on Literary Universe. Say hi to {from} on their profile.
invite.from.seoDescription: Join Literary Universe to read stories, explore fictional worlds and write your own. Creating an account is free.
invite.from.intro: Read stories, explore their worlds or start writing your own.
invite.from.togetherIntro: Your free account lets you read stories and write your own.
invite.from.readBody: Read stories, comment on chapters and look up characters and places in each universe's encyclopedia as you go.
invite.from.supportBody: Buy chapters or join a writer's fan club to support their work.
invite.from.writeTitle: Start a story of your own
invite.from.writeBody: Use your workshop to plan a world and write your first chapter.
invite.from.ticketMessage: Your account is free, and you keep the rights to your writing.
invite.from.faqFreeA: Yes. You can create a free account to read free stories and write your own. Some stories cost money, and paid plans add more tools.
invite.from.faqWriteA: No. You can join just to read. If you decide to write later, your account includes a workshop.
invite.writer.seoTitle: Build your universe and write your story
invite.writer.seoDescription: Plan your world, write your story and publish it in one place. Free to start, and your rights stay yours.
invite.writer.intro: Literary Universe is a workshop for your stories and the world they live in. Keep your characters and places in an encyclopedia, write chapter by chapter, then publish for free or sell your work.
invite.writer.stripMessage: Registration is free, and your rights stay yours under whichever license you pick.
invite.writer.featuresIntro: Plan it, write it, publish it and talk with the people reading it, without switching apps.
invite.writer.feature1Body: Keep characters, places, creatures and history in your universe's encyclopedia, then write your stories on top of it.
invite.writer.feature2Body: Add beta readers, co-authors and translators to a single story or to a whole universe.
invite.writer.feature3Body: Blogs, forums and your feed connect you with the people who follow your universe.
invite.writer.feature4Body: Sell chapters, whole books or bundles, or start a fan club. The platform fee is 10% under an exclusive license and 30% under a non-exclusive one.
invite.writer.note: You don't need the whole story.
invite.writer.faq1A: Yes. Creating universes and stories, translations, fan fiction, fan clubs and selling your work are all in the free plan. Paid plans add more tools, such as blogs, forums, a universe timeline and advanced statistics.
invite.writer.faq2Q: Who owns what I write here?
invite.writer.faq2A: You do. You keep your copyright and choose the license for every work, from Creative Commons to exclusive.
invite.writer.faq3A: Readers buy your chapters, books or bundles, or join your fan club. The platform fee is 10% under a Literary Universe exclusive license and 30% under a non-exclusive one, and payouts go through Stripe.
invite.writer.faq4A: Start free. When you want a blog, forums for your universe, a timeline or deeper statistics, the Adventurer plan adds them.
invite.writer.closingBody: Open your workshop, sketch your world and write the first page.
invite.writer.memberUpgrade: You are already one of us. The Adventurer plan adds blogs, forums for your universe, a timeline and advanced statistics.
invite.writer.memberThanks: Thank you for supporting Literary Universe. Your workshop is waiting.
invite.reader.seoTitle: Read stories with whole worlds behind them
invite.reader.seoDescription: Read stories, explore the universe behind each one and talk with other fans. Joining Literary Universe is free.
invite.reader.intro: Stories on Literary Universe live inside universes. Open the encyclopedia right from the chapter you're reading, then join the other fans on the forums.
invite.reader.stripMessage: An account costs nothing. Authors decide which stories are free and which are for sale.
invite.reader.featuresIntro: Characters, places, creatures, history. Authors write them down, and you can look them up without leaving the story.
invite.reader.feature1Body: Forgot who someone is? Open the universe encyclopedia from the reader and jump straight back in.
invite.reader.feature2Title: Follow the people behind the stories
invite.reader.feature2Body: Author blogs and universe pages tell you how a world was made and what is coming next.
invite.reader.feature3Body: Universe and author forums, blogs and your feed bring together people who love the same stories.
invite.reader.feature4Body: Light or dark, a dyslexia-friendly font, striped paragraphs or a reading ruler. Set up the reader for your eyes.
invite.reader.faq1Q: Do I have to pay to read?
invite.reader.faq1A: No. An account is free, and authors decide which stories are free and which are for sale. If you love a story, you can support its author by buying chapters or joining their fan club.
invite.reader.faq2A: The world a story is set in. Its author describes the characters, places and history in an encyclopedia, and several stories can share one universe.
invite.reader.faq3Q: What does the Explorer plan add?
invite.reader.faq3A: Reading lists, personal notes on stories and universes, writing challenges, user groups and a vote on new features.
invite.reader.faq4A: Any time. The same account opens a workshop for your own stories, and the free plan covers it.
invite.reader.closingBody: Make an account, follow the stories you like and explore the worlds behind them.
invite.reader.memberUpgrade: You are already one of us. The Explorer plan adds reading lists, personal notes on stories and universes, writing challenges and user groups.
invite.reader.memberThanks: Thank you for supporting Literary Universe. Ever thought about writing a story of your own? Your workshop is one click away.
invite.author.seoTitle: Bring your published books to Literary Universe
invite.author.seoDescription: Reach new readers, build a community around your books and keep 70 to 90% of every sale. Your rights stay yours and there is no lock-in.
invite.author.intro: You have already published. Here your books get a home where readers can explore the world behind them, and you keep 70 to 90% of every sale.
invite.author.stripMessage: Do you have published work that you would like to sell on Literary Universe?
invite.author.featuresIntro: No exclusivity unless you choose it. Your sales data is open to you, and your work exports as EPUB whenever you want.
invite.author.feature1Body: Your universe page and its encyclopedia give new readers a way into your books, and discovery helps them find you.
invite.author.feature2Body: Fan clubs with exclusive and early-access chapters, a blog and forums keep your readers close between books.
invite.author.feature3Body: Sales and financial data are open to you. The platform fee is 10% under an exclusive license and 30% under a non-exclusive one, with no hidden fees.
invite.author.feature4Body: You keep your rights and your files. Whole stories or single arcs export as EPUB, so you are never locked in.
invite.author.faq1Q: Can I sell books I've already published?
invite.author.faq1A: Yes, if you hold the rights to sell them here. Write to us at {email} and we'll help you set them up.
invite.author.faq2Q: How much of each sale do I keep?
invite.author.faq2A: Between 70 and 90%, before payment processing. The platform fee is 10% under a Literary Universe exclusive license and 30% under a non-exclusive one. Payouts go through Stripe in several currencies.
invite.author.faq3A: No. You keep your copyright, your sales data is open to you, and you can export whole stories or single arcs as EPUB.
invite.author.faq4A: Publishing and selling are in the free plan. Paid plans add tools such as blogs, forums and advanced statistics.
invite.author.closingBody: Write to us about the work you'd like to sell, or create an account and look around first.
invite.author.memberWelcome: Welcome back. Tell us about your published books and we'll help you bring them over.
invite.offer.sample: Sample offer for the review build. The real offer text and checkout code go here.
